rule: Only the user's explicit accept or decline decision changes a review group status.

lesson5-intransitive-vnc-structure.acceptedJob: Make the intransitive formula the automatic normal Result for an intransitive VNC source.

lesson5-morph-carrier-and-spelling.acceptedJob: Make morph identity part of the typed analysis while treating spelling as its contextual realization.

lesson5-subject-person-fillers.acceptedJob: Make subject person and number the only user choices while the application realizes the exact pers1 carrier.

lesson5-subject-case-filler.acceptedJob: Keep nominative case structurally present and automatically realized by zero.

lesson5-subject-number-connector.acceptedJob: Make num1 an automatic bridge between the predicate and final subject number.

lesson5-subject-number-suffix.acceptedJob: Make num2 the final automatic statement of subject number.

lesson5-subject-paradigms.acceptedJob: Make the four paradigms automatic consequences of ordinary grammatical choices.

lesson5-verbstem-categories.acceptedJob: Make the typed verbstem the source of lexical meaning and all required stem-category distinctions.

lesson5-mood-tense-system.acceptedJob: Make mood and tense genuine choices whose available combinations and morphs are enforced by the application.
